title: Athodai
extract:
Athodai is a Tenno hand-cannon that shoots long-ranged laser beams, with an Alternate Fire function that discharges all ammo to burst-fire in a short-ranged cone. Weak point kills with the primary fire increase the weapon's fire rate and grant infinite ammo, but locks out the Alternate Fire.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Heat damage.
Primary Fire shoots fully automatic rounds.
Weak point kills with primary fire trigger the Overdrive buff, increasing fire rate by +100%, Ammo Efficiency by +100%, and decreasing Recoil by -100% for 8 seconds.
Overdrive buff disables Alternate Fire for its duration, and cannot be refreshed.
Fire Rate and Recoil bonuses are additive to mods.
Alternate Fire shoots a cone of energy, ejecting all remaining ammunition in the magazine in a quick burst.
Pinpoint accuracy.
Innate 2 meter Punch Through.
Cone has a thickness of 2 meters.
Prevents zoom.
This prevents the buffs from  Hydraulic Crosshairs and  Sharpened Bullets from affecting this mode as a result.
Can equip the Athodai-exclusive  Pain Points mod.
Innate  polarity.

Acquisition
Athodai was acquired by watching TennoCon 2020 on WARFRAME's Twitch with a Twitch-linked account for 30 consecutive minutes, between 12:30 p.m. and 5:00 p.m. ET, on August 1st, 2020. It comes with a free weapon slot and pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Due to thousands of players reporting missing Twitch drops, on August 6th, 2020 Athodai was distributed to all players if they were logged in to WARFRAME during TennoCon 2020, regardless if they watched the streams or not. This resulted in some players receiving two Athodai.
Athodai's blueprint and components are now available in Venus Proxima Abandoned Derelict Caches in Empyrean missions. All parts can be traded between players.

Notes
Overdrive buff grants +100% fire rate, -100% Recoil, and allows it to consume no ammo while firing, but disables the Alternate Fire feature. The buff lasts for 8 seconds.
The buff triggers only on enemy weakpoints, not ones generated by either  Sonar or  Detect Vulnerability.
Overdrive's fire rate buff is additive to other fire rate increases, such as  Gunslinger,  Lethal Torrent,  Gauss's  Redline, or  Wisp's Haste  Reservoirs.
Duration cannot be refreshed.
Overdrive takes precedence over  Arcane Pistoleer, preventing the Arcane from triggering.
The Alternate Fire ejects all of the remaining ammunition in the magazine in a single burst.
Because of this fact, increasing the magazine size of the weapon such as with  Slip Magazine and using recoil reduction mods like  Steady Hands can help to make its damage output more consistent and reliable.
Alternate Fire can be interrupted (preserving the ammunition left in the magazine) by rolling or quick melee.
Alternate Fire will not function under the effects of any ammo efficiency or infinite ammo buff (Energized Munitions, Overdrive, Arcane Pistoleer, Reactant Buff), instead firing only for few seconds or not firing at all.

Tips
 Hydraulic Crosshairs and  Secondary Deadhead pairs well with the primary fire's Overdrive buff.
